audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[0] tells you to 'dodge Dark Matter and punish the long cooldown' — Dark Matter is the one spell with effectively no cooldown, and his stacks shorten it further. The range relationship that decides the lane (Event Horizon 725, Primordial Burst 650 versus your Q 970 and charm 975) is stated nowhere, and dosFull[2] calls the cage a 'fifteen-second' cooldown when it is 20s at rank 1.

audit.corrected: Punishable cooldown re-pointed at Event Horizon, ranges stated, and the missing-health scaling on his ultimate added.
